#   起点与时值以四分音符为 1（quarter note = 1）；音名为实际拼写（G# = G♯，F = F♮）。
#   原谱拍号 ¢，按 2/2 记：每小节 4 个四分音符。

# 结构 Form as printed: bars 1–8, ":||:" after bar 8 (end-repeat of bars 1–8; the start-repeat dots after it have
#   no closing repeat), bars 9–16, bars 17–24 = bars 1–8 written out, plain double bar at the end.
#   The copy has a later pencil note "No repeat" beside the final bar (not part of the print).
# 声部 Parts (11 staves per system, top to bottom):
#   fl_vln1 = "Trav: e Viol: 1°" (G2 clef)   fl_vln2 = "Trav: e Viol: 2°" (G2)
#   horn1 / horn2 = "Corno 1°" / "Corno 2°" (G2, no key signature) — WRITTEN pitch, horn in G (sounds a 4th lower)
#   ob1 / ob2 = "Hautb: 1° e 2°" (one G2 staff; upper / lower notes)   viola = "Viola" (C3)
#   soprano (C1), alto (C3), tenor (C4), bass (F4): the chorus, unlabelled in the print (text under each staff)
#   bc = lowest staff (F4) with figures. Figures are not encoded (see README).
#   Lyrics not encoded. Slurs not encoded.
# 临时记号按原印本：印了才写；调号一个升号（圆号除外）。Accidentals as printed; key signature one sharp (not the horns).
